context:
First decide the reading order, then adjust components. Avoid changing
comparability logic while fixing presentation unless a test proves the logic
is wrong. Use shared chart and status primitives where available. Verify with
both same-cohort and mixed-scale compare cases from PR #246.
description:
PR #246 found that Result Detail and Compare are auditable but not yet sharp
enough for decision-making. Result Detail overweights the Run Receipt before
the primary metric/action, Compare overweights the Comparability Receipt
before the decision/chart read, mobile Result Detail charts clip, and the
same-cohort Compare speedup chart wastes large plot space for equal values.

This TODO turns those screenshots into a concrete implementation plan for
single-result interpretation and multi-result comparison. The goal is not to
demote reproducibility; it is to make reproducibility, metric interpretation,
comparability, baseline choice, and chart evidence work in the right order.

anti_patterns.dont: bury reproducibility so far down the page that a result no longer feels auditable.
claim or imply a winner when comparability logic suppresses winner claims.
default to a sparse chart when a two-result equal-value state is clearer.
introduce a user-selectable primary metric toggle unless the benchmark-derived metric contract is intentionally reopened.
use chart labels that overflow the SVG or require horizontal page scroll.

preserves.behavior: Comparability receipt logic and winner-claim suppression behavior.
Compare route `?ids=` share URL contract and compact ID canonicalization.
Run Receipt reproducibility details, download links, and provenance metadata.

verifications.command: cd results-explorer && npm test -- src/pages/__tests__/ResultDetail.test.tsx src/pages/__tests__/Compare.test.tsx src/components/__tests__/CompareSummary.test.tsx src/components/__tests__/ComparabilityReceipt.test.tsx src/components/__tests__/QueryDiffTable.test.tsx
verifications.description: Result Detail and Compare tests pass

verifications.command: echo 'Manual: recapture Result Detail and Compare at 390, 768, 1280, 1600 plus mixed-scale Compare and compare against PR #246 screenshots'
verifications.description: Manual PR #246 detail/compare recapture is clean
verifications.expected: manual evidence shows VH-3, VH-4, DQ-3, DQ-4, and DQ-8 resolved or explicitly deferred

work_units.summary: Map the first-viewport decision hierarchy for Result Detail and Compare

work_units.notes:
Replace inline receipt metrics with a compact summary module or metric
cards. Keep Run Receipt visible enough to support auditability, but do
not let receipt/environment metadata consume the whole first analytical
viewport. Group `Compare this result`, download, and reproducibility
actions consistently near the top summary.

Acceptance evidence:
- recaptured 390px and 1280px detail screenshots show primary metrics and
  at least one primary action before detailed receipt sections dominate;
- trust/validation/source labels are visible but subordinate to the
  primary metric.
work_units.summary: Redesign Result Detail top summary and receipt placement

work_units.notes:
Compare must lead with a compact comparability status and decision
summary. Move baseline controls close to ratio/delta interpretation. Keep
warning counts and specific differences visible, but collapse or compact
matched receipt details so the first viewport does not read as a receipt
inventory before showing the comparison outcome.
